title: Barchi jawaan ke dil me naya dar hai kargayi
body:
barchhi jawa'n ke dil me naya dar hai kargayi
laila ke dil pe ek qayamat guzar gayi
shaadi bhi kar na payi miti dil ki aarzu
bete ke saath haaye
<<DIVIDER>>
bete ke saath hasrath e madar bhi margayi
atthara saal waale ko naazo'n se paal kar
laila pisar ke haaye
laila pisar ke gham me jaha'n se guzar gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
laila pe shaam aayi qayamat ke saath saath aur uske saath haaye aur uske saath uski umeed-e-saher gayi
dekha sina'n ka phal tha jo qalbe jawaan me
khoon e jigar ke haaye
khoone jigar ke saath hi sheh ki nazar gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
besaaya lash dekhke us noujawaan ki
pucho na kaise haaye
pucho na kaise haal me laila wo ghar gayi
iqbal deedni hai khuloose aza ki shaan
<<DIVIDER>>
khudrat khuda ki haaye
khudrat khuda ki deen ki pal me sanwar gayi
